title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 2: the laws for the meal offering of fine flour, its oil, frankincense and salt.

questions.text: What was poured and put on the fine flour of a meal offering?
questions.explanation: His offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

questions.text: What did the priest take from the meal offering to burn as its memorial?
questions.explanation: He took his handful of its fine flour and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and burned its memorial on the altar.

answers.text: Half of the flour, but none of the oil
A handful of flour and oil, with all the frankincense
All of the flour, oil and frankincense together
A tenth part of the flour and oil, but none of the frankincense

questions.text: To whom did the rest of the meal offering belong?
questions.explanation: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

questions.text: What should a meal offering baked in the oven be?
questions.explanation: It shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

answers.text: Round loaves with yeast and salt
Unleavened cakes or wafers with oil

questions.text: What was to be done with a meal offering made on a griddle?
questions.explanation: It was to be of unleavened fine flour mixed with oil. You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it.

answers.text: Burn all of it at once, without any oil
Cut it in pieces and pour oil on it

questions.text: After the meal offering was presented to the priest, what did he do with it?
questions.explanation: The meal offering was presented to the priest, and he brought it to the altar.

answers.text: He brought it to the altar
He gave it back to the one who offered it
He set it on the table in the tent
He took it outside the camp

questions.text: Which two things were never to be burned as an offering made by fire to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: No meal offering shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

questions.text: With what was every meal offering to be seasoned?
questions.explanation: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt; the salt of the covenant of your God was not to be lacking.

questions.text: What was to be offered for a meal offering of first fruits?
questions.explanation: For the meal offering of first fruits you shall offer fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

answers.text: Fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed
Loaves of bread baked with yeast
Whole grapes and ripe figs from the vineyard and the field

questions.text: What did the priest burn with part of the crushed grain and oil of the first fruits?
questions.explanation: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense.
